name: Horn of Blasting

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Blast
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): a 30-ft cone: DC 15 Con save or 5d6 Thunder and Deafened for 1 minute (half, not Deafened, on a success). 20% chance the horn explodes (10d6 Fire to you).

summary: Once a day, a blast in a 30-ft cone (Con DC 15, 5d6 Thunder, Deafened); each use risks the horn exploding.
text: You can take a Magic action to blow the horn, which emits a thunderous blast in a 30-foot Cone that is audible 600 feet away. Each creature in the Cone makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d6 Thunder damage and has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. Glass or crystal objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried take 10d6 Thunder damage. Each use of the horn's magic has a 20 percent chance of causing the horn to explode. The explosion deals 10d6 Fire damage to the user and destroys the horn. The horn can't be used again until the next dawn.
